scope: Pre-output validity correction, not a task-quality result
finding: The forced closing-token mask can overwrite NaN, positive infinity or all-masked raw neural logits before the sampler checks them.
action: Do not roll out prototype task generation. Preserve it and register the guarded sibling protocol separately.
guard: Read-only neural-logit reduction before steering sets the existing sampler's sticky invalid-inference flag; normal generation rejects it.
limitations: Software checks alone do not qualify real-model GPU integration or establish improved code generation.
